title: HYDRA: A Heterogeneous Chiplet DSE Framework for Serving Dynamic Hybrid LLM Workloads
abstract: arXiv:2608.19395v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Hybrid Transformer-Mamba large language models (LLMs) enhance long-context efficiency, but their heterogeneous computation and communication patterns complicate efficient hardware acceleration. Chiplet-based architectures offer a scalable solution by integrating specialized compute and memory units. However, the design space spanning static architectural configurations and dynamic runtime policies is prohibitively large to explore exhaustively. To address this challenge, we present HYDRA, a comprehensive design space exploration framework for hybrid LLM serving on heterogeneous chiplet systems. HYDRA jointly explores chiplet composition, placement, inter-chiplet bandwidth provisioning, dynamic batching, and runtime scheduling. It integrates communication-aware placement, dynamic batching, elastic task scheduling, and a fast Markov-based performance estimator that captures multi-tenant runtime dynamics for efficient and accurate explora

translated_title: HYDRA：面向动态混合LLM工作负载的异构芯片组DSE框架
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.19395v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：混合Transformer-Mamba大型语言模型（LLM）提升了长上下文效率，但其异构计算和通信模式使高效硬件加速变得复杂。基于芯片组的架构通过集成专用计算和内存单元提供了可扩展的解决方案。然而，涵盖静态架构配置和动态运行时策略的设计空间过于庞大，无法进行穷举探索。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了HYDRA，一个针对异构芯片组系统上混合LLM服务的全面设计空间探索框架。HYDRA联合探索芯片组组成、放置、芯片间带宽配置、动态批处理和运行时调度。它集成了通信感知放置、动态批处理、弹性任务调度以及基于马尔可夫的快速性能估计器，该估计器捕获多租户运行时动态，以实现高效且准确的探索。
tldr: HYDRA提出了一个联合优化静态架构和动态运行时策略的异构芯片组设计空间探索框架，通过通信感知放置和马尔可夫性能估计器高效服务混合Transformer-Mamba LLM工作负载。
en_tdlr: HYDRA proposes a heterogeneous chiplet design space exploration framework that jointly optimizes static architecture and dynamic runtime policies, efficiently serving hybrid Transformer-Mamba LLM workloads via communication-aware placement and a Markov-based performance estimator.
